normal.text: Last week or so I finished my very first Final Fantasy game: The Pixel Remaster of Final Fantasy VI. I heard a lot of good things about it and this year I finally (sic!) started a genuine attempt to play it. What can I say? Such a great game. Lovely characters, epic plot, well narrated. And the music! The Pixel Remaster has a newly recorded orchestral soundtrack, which is epic... 🧵1/2 #retrogaming #finalfantasy #finalfantasy6 #finalfantasyvi #jrpg #rpg #videogames
